description: This is a Python script implementing a wrapper for the pyrefly linter, handling command execution, JSON parsing of lint errors, and integration with CI environments.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details such as path, line, severity, and description.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with retries and logs execution time.

methods.name: check_pyrefly_installed
methods.description: Checks if pyrefly is installed by running 'pyrefly --version'.

methods.name: in_github_actions
methods.description: Detects if the script is running in a GitHub Actions environment.

methods.name: check_files
methods.description: Runs the pyrefly check command, parses JSON output, and returns lint messages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up argument parsing, logging, and runs the linter process.
